title: α-Fe 1 keV self-ion cascade (structural demo)
summary: BCC iron, 12³ cells (~3456 atoms), 300 K, one 1 keV Fe PKA. Uses the D–T scenario id for workflow practice, but PKA species is Fe (host) — never the divertor preset’s W.
warnings: Attach Zhou04 Fe via NIST (nist-zhou04-fe → fe-eam-placeholder catalog slot) before Submit for real MD.
Earlier 10 keV / 8³ recipes lost atoms on Zhou04 Fe (EAM rhomax). This demo uses 1 keV + 12³ + cascade safety timestep.
If you raise energy above ~2 keV without enlarging the cell or stitching ZBL, expect Lost atoms / unphysical WS counts.
user_walkthrough: Material: Iron (α-Fe) — PKA must stay Fe.
Potential: Acquire Zhou04 Fe; confirm Engines / Potential shows ● ready (not placeholder).
Submit → Run → Results. Compare vacancy/SIA proxies to the W example.
Optional: raise energy and click Apply recommended cell before production studies.
